brand_spec.notes: BrandSpec 'classical' motion philosophy (400ms cubic-bezier spring) applied. VisualDirection overrides heading font to Lora per typography_hierarchy. Heading font applied as Lora in tailwind.config + globals.css; BrandSpec Merriweather retained as fallback reference.

visual_direction.primary_change: Typography refinement (Lora serif headings), elevated service cards, classical motion (400ms cubic-bezier spring) with subtle scale(1.02) on hover.
visual_direction.rationale: Classical liberal arts brand requires refined, contemplative aesthetics. Lora conveys credibility and warmth. Source Sans 3 body maintains readability. No new colors introduced.
designer_notes: BrandSpec 'classical' motion philosophy (400ms ease-out with cubic-bezier spring) applied to all interactive elements
Service cards use elevated variant with larger shadow on hover
Portfolio gallery items use motion-subtle (opacity fade)
Contact form inputs feature subtle border-color transition
All colors trace to BrandSpec tokens
Dark mode uses [data-theme="dark"] with full_tokens strategy

ui_polish_changes.change: Defined BrandSpec tokens as CSS custom properties (--color-primary, --color-accent, --motion-duration, --motion-easing) with full_tokens dark mode overrides under [data-theme='dark']
ui_polish_changes.reason: Establishes single source of truth for the design system; enables runtime dark mode and prevents hardcoded hex drift

ui_polish_changes.change: Added :focus-visible ring (2px solid var(--color-accent), offset 2px) on all interactive elements; never use outline:none without replacement
ui_polish_changes.reason: WCAG 2.4.7 focus visible - keyboard-only users must see focus

ui_polish_changes.change: Added @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that clamps all animation/transition durations to 0.01ms
ui_polish_changes.reason: WCAG 2.3.3 - users who request reduced motion must not see vestibular-trigger animations

ui_polish_changes.change: Added .text-balance and .text-pretty utilities and applied to hero h1, hero paragraph, and all section h2s
ui_polish_changes.reason: Prevents orphans/widows in serif headings and improves classical-typography feel without changing the visual hierarchy

ui_polish_changes.change: Set fontFamily.heading = ['Lora','Georgia','serif']; body = ['Source Sans 3','system-ui','sans-serif']; mapped motion-classical/monastic/subtle as transitionTimingFunction
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection typography_hierarchy explicitly specifies Lora for headings; BrandSpec's Merriweather reference is preserved as fallback note in brand_spec.notes

ui_polish_changes.change: .card-elevated:hover applies transform: scale(1.02) + box-shadow var(--shadow-lg) + border-color var(--color-accent) over 400ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)
ui_polish_changes.reason: Maps directly to VisualDirection.motion_class_map.card_elevated_hover = motion-classical and component_variants_priority [elevated, primary]

ui_polish_changes.change: .form-input uses 200ms ease border-color + 3px primary-container focus ring; .form-label uses 0.875rem uppercase 0.02em tracking
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_class_map.form_input_focus = motion-subtle; uppercase eyebrow labels reinforce editorial BrandSpec voice

ui_polish_changes.change: Hero uses 70% primary-color overlay over the wixstatic hero image; preserves original CDN URL per image_strategy=preserve-cdn
ui_polish_changes.reason: Original Wix hero relied on the same dramatic background; overlay ensures WCAG AA contrast for white headline text on the photograph

ui_polish_changes.change: Cards use card-elevated variant; grid is grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 (matches VisualDirection.page_layouts.services responsive_columns 640:2, 1024:4)
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection explicit section layout for / services grid

ui_polish_changes.change: Grid uses grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5 (640:1, 768:2, 1024:3, 1280:5 per VisualDirection.portfolio.responsive_columns)
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection section_layouts.portfolio.responsive_columns is exact; honoring it preserves 5-up desktop gallery intent

ui_polish_changes.change: Process uses <ol> with grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 + numbered prefixes (01, 02, 03) in accent color; md: gap-6 lg:gap-8 for breathing room on classical layout
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.process layout 3-column with responsive 640:1 1024:3; numerical prefixes convey classical order without iconography

ui_polish_changes.change: Two-column layout grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[auto_1fr]; stacks below 768px per VisualDirection.about.responsive_layout.768=stacked
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.about explicit two-column with portrait + content; responsive stacking respects the spec

ui_polish_changes.change: Implemented with react-hook-form + zodResolver; aria-invalid/aria-describedby wired; success state announces via role=status aria-live=polite; submitted=true shows confirmation
ui_polish_changes.reason: Builder rule: forms use React Hook Form + Zod; required field indicators + error messages meet WCAG 3.3.1/3.3.3

ui_polish_changes.change: Footer uses bg-primary (#1E293B) for high contrast against accent-200 hover states; social icon buttons use ghost-style 40x40 outlined squares with motion-subtle
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_class_map.footer_link_hover = motion-subtle; primary-color background ties footer to BrandSpec while providing contrast for the inverse text

ui_polish_changes.change: Added skip-to-main-content link as the first focusable element; aria-labelledby on every section; semantic <main id=main> wraps content
ui_polish_changes.reason: WCAG 2.4.1 bypass blocks; helps screen reader and keyboard users

ui_polish_changes.change: Preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com; load Lora 400/500/600/700/400italic + Source Sans 3 300-700 via single stylesheet
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection typography requires both Lora and Source Sans 3 with italic + weight variants; preconnect reduces CLS and improves LCP

visual_weight_issues: Hero overlay is 70% primary-color opacity; on very light portions of the Simon Berger photo this still passes AA but borderline - acceptable since headline uses weight 700 and font-size 4xl-6xl
Footer social icons currently use single-letter glyphs (L, G, X) inside a 40x40 square - functional but minimal; consider SVG glyphs in a polish iteration if desired
typography_hierarchy_suggestions: H1 jumps from 4xl to 6xl between mobile and desktop which is a 1.5x scale; the type_scale defines 5xl=48px; could add an intermediate 5xl breakpoint for tablet to soften the jump
emotional_resonance_gaps: The 'classical liberal arts' tone is carried through serif typography and warm copy but is not yet echoed visually in an emblematic mark or pattern - acceptable for v1 since brand_spec did not mandate a custom logotype
brand_token_violations: VisualDirection.designer_notes mentioned accent_color #7C3AED but VisualDirection.color_delta was null; applied BrandSpec accent_color #6366F1 throughout per the explicit 'color_delta is authoritative' rule - duplication logged in Gap Ledger
self_critique.recommended_action: None - acceptable trade-off. All component hover/focus/active states match VisualDirection.motion_class_map. The 70% hero overlay is the single borderline item and is documented above.
